surplus_rule: A tracked file is surplus if it is outside root_files/root_dirs, outside research/README.md, or matches a generated ignored pattern without being explicitly justified here.
missing_rule: A site-visible fact is missing if it has no source file, no writer, no publication route, or no test guarding the route.
